entries.name: Stamp duty on transfer deeds of immovable property (0,35 % up to E7 000, 0,85 % of the whole value above)
entries.statute: Stamp Duties Act, 1970 (Act 37 of 1970) s. 4 (duty per the Schedule), s. 4bis (Schedule amended by Gazette notice), s. 8 (m), Schedule item 24 'Transfer deed relating to immovable property' (eSwatiniLII consolidation at 1 December 1998 via Wayback 20230923031008, R4/fetch/p17/sz_sda1970_lii1998.html). B: the 1998 edition; notices under s. 4bis after 1998 (eSwatiniLII lists a 2000 Gazette citing the Act) were not read (flag). Charged in addition to the transfer duty (P5)
entries.doc: Item 24: '(1) Where the value or consideration does not exceed E7,000: for every E100 or part thereof of the value or consideration 0 35; (2) Where the value or consideration exceeds E7,000: for every E100 part thereof of the value or consideration 0 85'; the higher of value and consideration. Worked case (hand): a home bought for E1 000 000 -> 10 000 x E0,85 = E8 500 (plus transfer duty E58 000, P5). Seventeenth pass.
unsupported: 'for every E100 or part thereof': the value is not rounded up to the next E100 here
liability: s. 8 (m) names the person executing the instrument; charged on the purchase (the buyer) as in practice (flag)
exempt partition transfers and transfers that do not alter legal rights; other items (bonds 0,40 per E100, leases item 16) not modelled
Schedule changes by notice under s. 4bis after 1998 not checked

entries.name: Eswatini National Provident Fund, employer contribution (5 % of wages up to E4 000 a month)
entries.statute: Eswatini National Provident Fund Order 1974; ENPF (Statutory Contributions) Regulations, Legal Notice No. 5 of 2025 reg. 2 (1) (a) (as reproduced by the Fund, held sz/law/w5/enpf_home_notice_LN5_2025.txt); rate 5 % + 5 % from the Fund's 'Statutory Contributions Calculations 2023' table (Wayback, R4/fetch/sz11)
entries.doc: LN 5/2025 reg. 2 (1): statutory contributions are payable in respect of wages of '(a) Four Thousand Emalangeni (E4,000.00) or less during any calendar month for 2025'; ENPF table: on wages of 300,00 the amount submitted is 30,00, employee's share 15,00 and employer's share 15,00 (5 % each).
unsupported: the ceiling applies month by month (reg. 2 (2)); the annual cap 48 000 is exact for even monthly pay
public provident fund (individual accounts) treated as a social contribution, as UG and KE NSSF

entries.name: Training levy (Industrial and Vocational Training Act, employer): not levied
entries.statute: Industrial and Vocational Training Act 16 of 1982 s. 11-13 (EswatiniLII, Wayback 2023-09-23, R4/fetch/p14/sz_ivta1982.txt); OECD Revenue Statistics detailed table for Eswatini (sdmx.oecd.org DSD_REV_AFRICA@DF_REVSWZ 2.0, fetched 2026-11-22, R4/fetch/swp/oecd_SWZ.csv)
entries.why: SZ: no payroll tax or training levy charged in 2025 (grade B). The 1982 Act lets the Minister impose a levy only by a training levy order for a given industry (s. 13 (1), below 1 % of pay, s. 13 (2) (c)); no such order was located, the revenue authority lists no skills levy, and the OECD Revenue Statistics table for Eswatini books 0 under heading 3000 in every year it publishes (2021, 2022, 2023; 2024 and 2025 not yet published). Not an absence proved from a text: an industry order could exist (flag).
unsupported: an industry training levy order under s. 13 (if any) not located

entries.name: Transfer duty on acquisitions of fixed property (2 % to E40 000, 4 % to E60 000, 6 % above)
entries.statute: Transfer Duty Act 8 of 1902 s. 3 as amended by Act 8 of 1985 (eSwatiniLII version at 1 December 1998, Wayback capture 2023-09-27, R4/fetch/p15/sz_tda1902_lii1998.txt). Edition 1998, no later amending Act in hand: B (flag). Liability: the person acquiring the property (s. 3 (a))
entries.doc: s. 3: 'a duty of (i) two per cent on the first E40,000; (ii) four per cent on any amount exceeding E40,000, but not exceeding E60,000; and (iii) six per cent on any amount exceeding E60,000 of the value of any fixed property ... shall be payable and paid by the person (a) acquiring or becoming entitled to any such property ... by way of purchase, cession, exchange, donation or in any manner otherwise than by way of legacy'. Fifteenth pass.
unsupported: leases of fixed property (s. 3 (b), on the full value of the property)
exemptions of s. 13 (Ngwenyama for the Swazi nation, partitions between co-owners)
donations (charged on the value): gifts not modelled
